outcome: An agent can use the installed executable and published contracts without reading source.

artifacts.purpose: Concise declarative overview, tested installation and limits

interfaces: Document cargo install --path . --locked --root <isolated-install-root> and explicit PATH/binary identity; verify the exact installed executable hash.
Examples cover both tasks, failure discovery by fields, policy selection, strict errors, exact subset preparation, intersections and schema use.
Explain population/reference limitations, probability/observation differences and sensitive snapshot handling.
acceptance_criteria: Installation succeeds on the pinned tested host; --version identifies the executable package, and docs/schema/report fields identify specification and wire versions.
Examples run with the installed binary using public synthetic inputs; no repository-specific scoring edits.
No claims of reference truth, calibrated probabilities, significance or deployment suitability.

verification.procedure: Run cargo install --path . --locked --root <isolated-install-root>; invoke its bin/validator --version and both documented synthetic command sequences; preserve hash, commands and exits.
verification.expected: Installation command succeeds on the pinned tested host, and --version identifies package/spec/wire information as documented. Examples run with the installed binary using public synthetic inputs; no repository-specific scoring edits. No claims of reference truth, calibrated probabilities, significance or deployment suitability.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
common_completion_checks: All listed artifacts contain implemented behavior or required evidence; no placeholders.

All tests assigned to this task are listed by Cargo and execute with a nonzero expected test count. Compound conformance/structure cases have explicit later audit test owners in coverage.json; implementers still test each local invariant now.
Relevant fmt/Clippy/test/build checks pass on the pinned toolchain; no bypass, changed tolerance or weakened oracle.
Saved response records exact input/source/output hashes, commands, exit codes, expected/actual results, and unresolved failures.
New or changed-authority artifacts are indexed; operational state is updated in Fizzy after acceptance.
